_comment: Machine-local settings for `npm run test:real`. This file is NOT committed — .gitignore covers
it — and no secret ever belongs in it: there is no field for a password, an MFA secret, a cookie
or an API key, because the run never needs one. The DeepSeek key is entered in the product's own
Settings screen and stays in the browser profile.
Delete a field, or this whole file, and the run still works: it uses .tmp/syllab-qa-profile and
takes the Courses in the order the Semester Dashboard lists them.
